text:
maria: CI on main is red after the constraints merge. macos-latest job hangs at 'Building wheel for pybind11' step for >10m. Link: https://ci.internal/runs/12345

jonathan: Can you paste the failing log lines?

maria: ```
Running setup.py bdist_wheel for pybind11 ...
Building wheel for pybind11 (pyproject.toml) ...
  Running build_ext
  error: command 'clang' failed with exit code 1
```

ci-bot: (automated) job 12345 failed — macos-latest/install

kevin: I've seen clang build failures when pip falls back to building from sdist (no wheel). Likely the bump changed available wheels or manylinux tags. Quick things to try: `pip install --prefer-binary pybind11==2.12.1` or compare pip versions. Also check if our mac runner lacks dev headers.

tara: Was the lockfile regenerated in the PR or just constraints updated?

maria: constraints-only merge (no lock regen). The constraints PR bumped setuptools and transitive pybind11 pin.

jonathan: Can someone repro locally on macos: `python -m pip install pybind11==2.12.1` vs `2.10.0` — if 2.12.1 falls back to sdist that explains the clang error.

kevin: I'll spin up a quick mac VM and test. If it repros, we should either pin to the last wheeled version or force binary installs for that package in CI.

maria: thanks. If kevin confirms, we should bisect which constraint caused it — might be an index/host change removing wheels. @kevin please report back.

kevin: repro done — 2.12.1 pulled sdist and attempted to build, failed because our CI image is missing some dev headers; 2.10.0 installs from wheel. Looks like wheel not published for our build tag.

maria: OK plan: revert the pybind11 bump in constraints and rerun CI. Filing a quick follow-up now.

jonathan: +1 on reverting. Also want a CI change to `pip --prefer-binary` for install steps in build jobs so we catch this earlier.

maria: Created PR 5678 to pin pybind11==2.10.0 in constraints and triggered a rerun.

ci-bot: job 12345 rerun queued

kevin: opened an issue with the packaging team about the missing mac wheel for 2.12.1 — tracking: PKG-982 :ticket: 

tara: Thanks all — triaged for now. Reopen if rerun still fails. :thumbsup:
